title: Walt Disney Birthplace House

services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: There are several ways to move through the Birthplace! Click on an orange target icon to advance into that area. To look around a space, simply click and hold your mouse icon on the image and move your mouse to change your point of view. You can look in every direction! If your mouse has a scroll wheel, you may use that to zoom in and out of an image. And if you’d like to jump to any room from anywhere else, simply use the row of thumbnails along the bottom to select a space in the home. Clicking on the main image will hide the thumbnails. blurb: Please join us for a special books signing event with New York Times Best Selling Author AJ Wolfe, as we bring together Disney fans, families, and supporters of the Walt Disney Birthplace for an intimate and memorable experience at the historic home where Walt Disney was born.
